answer_1.quote: Our study addresses this gap by exploring the potential of LLMs to create mirror stories-narratives that genuinely reflect and resonate with the identities of individual readers.

answer_2.quote: We analyzed how personalization elements impact textual diversity using the Shannon Diversity Index (SDI).

answer_3.quote: GPT-4 (ver. 0613) was used as an evaluator in both experiments...it was used to evaluate the stories for satisfaction, quality, engagement, and personalness.

answer_4.quote: In both experiments, the same 26 human evaluators-all students from diverse disciplines-were tasked with evaluating the narratives.
answer_4.guideline: They provided feedback on all three story types, rating them on satisfaction, quality, engagement, and personalness.
